context: Checks that overrides are used only when CSS is not enough, with the slot found from the reference, wrapped and registered correctly.

checklist.name: Colour change not an override
checklist.description: Says the header colour change needs CSS rather than a component override and points to `starlight-theme`

checklist.name: Pages belong to base setup
checklist.description: Says the new page and sidebar entry belong to `starlight-base`

checklist.name: Identifies the slot from the reference
checklist.description: Looks up the slot name in the Overrides Reference or Overrides Map before building

checklist.name: Uses the exact listed slot name
checklist.description: Registers the component under the exact listed name such as `Hero`

checklist.name: Avoids the internal import
checklist.description: Declines to import the unlisted internal component

checklist.name: Wraps the default
checklist.description: Imports the default component and wraps it instead of copying its markup

checklist.name: Registers with a relative path
checklist.description: Registers the file in `components: {}` with a `./src/...` path

checklist.name: Does not rely on the file name
checklist.description: Registers by key and does not assume the file name selects the slot

checklist.name: States when to override
checklist.description: Explains overrides are for needs that CSS cannot address
